high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a product called the "Aurobindo Kulhar" in teal color with a capacity of 200ml. The ad is from the Instagram account "dancingleafteas," as indicated by the username at the top left corner. The post is marked as "Sponsored." The main focus of the image is a beautifully designed ceramic cup with a teal background and intricate gold floral patterns etched onto it. The cup is placed on a marble surface, which adds to the luxurious feel of the advertisement. The text in the image reads: "A Modern Twist On The Traditional Kulhar"
